card.summary: No free tier and no trial is published; the entry box is 'For $5 Per Month Only' with 100 GB and unlimited bandwidth.

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial is published; the entry box is 'For $5 Per Month Only' with 100 GB and unlimited bandwidth.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total disk (100 GB / 500 GB / 1000 GB); no single-file cap is published

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: 'Every SeedBox comes with a UNLIMITED BLAZING FAST 1GBPS connections. Download, Seed as much as you can! No limits on bandwidth, PERIOD.' The entry tier lists 'Unlimited Bandwidth' and 'SFTP & File Manager'.

record.interface_detail: 'SFTP & File Manager' on the entry tier; upper tiers add root access and a dedicated IP. No rsync or API is named.
record.tooling: SFTP client plus the file manager; ruTorrent WebUI; no CLI or API documented
record.chaining: A USD 5 100 GB box with an SFTP pull path; the 100 GB disk is the practical limit and the 'unlimited' claim is unverifiable without an account

limits.value: 1 Gbps shared per server; no per-account rate published

record.limits_note: No byte quota and no object cap; 'unlimited' is a claim, and the entry tier's 100 GB disk is the number a buyer can actually plan around.
record.binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary fails at 1 TiB/month on the published terms; the 100 GB disk forces ten cycles and the unstated fair-use rule is the risk.

identity_cost.detail: Account plus payment; a promo code ('ROCKET') is advertised for new customers. No phone or document check is stated.

record.reliability_note: 'Unlimited bandwidth, PERIOD' with no fair-use clause published; oversubscription on a shared 1 Gbps port is not observable before purchase.
record.confidence_note: Entry price, storage, protocol and the unlimited claim are on the live vendor page read. A measured rung needs a slot and a timed transfer.

evidence.proved: 'Minimal rTorrent Seedbox ... 100GB Storage ... Unlimited Bandwidth ... SFTP & File Manager ... For $5 Per Month Only'; USD 10/500 GB and USD 20/1000 GB tiers with root access and dedicated IP

record.notes: Exactly USD 5 for 100 GB, the same price as Leechdrive's 50 GB, so it is the better of the two on capacity and the worse on published detail (no FAQ, no fair-use page). Sustained-rate conversion: unlimited claimed on 1 Gbps, 125 MB/s theoretical; 1 TiB/month needs 3.39 Mbit/s. Potential constraints: a fair-use cap, per-server contention, or storage-only limits; the first is not published and cannot be confirmed without buying.

extras.apps: ruTorrent WebUI, rTorrent; Plex tiers at USD 10 and USD 20 include root access and a dedicated IP
